Technical

Stats

LOW_BlushingMermaid_Redcap_Caster
Redcap Mystic Cannoneer are archetypes of Redcap fey creatures in the The Blushing Mermaid during Act Three, similar to the Redcaps found in Act One.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Bloodlust ()
Healing: 3~18
3d6⁠Healing
The redcap's bloodthirsty cries fill one of its allies with bloodlust. It heals when it kills a creature and can attack three times.
 Range: 12 m (40 ft)
 Recharge: Once per combat
 Open Wounds ()
Damage: 2~12
2d6⁠Piercing
Rend a creature's flesh and make them  Bleed.
 DEX Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Throw ()   –  Scrap and Shrapnel Grenade
Damage
Normal weapon damage

Throw a character or item from the world or your inventory.

Your Strength affects how much weight you can throw. Heavier items deal more damage.

The damage of weapons with the thrown property is the same as the weapon's melee damage.

 Range: 3-18 m (10-60 ft)
